summary: Mobile responsiveness verified across 8 real-emulated device profiles (iPhone SE 320, iPhone 14 390, Android 360, Huawei 360, iPad 820, iPhone landscape 844, Desktop 1366, Desktop 1920) with proper mobile UAs, is_mobile=True, has_touch=True. For each profile checked 6 public pages + 13 admin + 6 siswa + 5 tentor + 7 proktor = up to 42 pages. Result: ZERO horizontal overflow on all pages/devices (scrollWidth == innerWidth everywhere). Hamburger/mobile sidebar Sheet opens correctly for all four roles on all three narrow devices (320/360/390). Touch devices get computed input font-size = 16px (iOS zoom prevention works); desktop keeps 14px. CBT engine for siswa@lms.id on to_3 ('Latihan Soal Campuran Aktif') renders on both iPhone 14 and desktop with the fullscreen gate ('Masuk Layar Penuh & Lanjutkan'), question 1/5, timer, options A-D, mobile nav testids (m-prev-question, m-next-question, m-flag-question, m-open-palette) present. No overflow on exam engine. The entire responsive-layout fix set applied by main agent (ManageUsers, CourseContent, ManageTryouts, TryoutBuilder, PublicShell, SiteSettings, index.css iOS 16px/overflow-x:clip/text-size-adjust) is confirmed working.
action_items: MINOR testability: fullscreen-gate button ('Masuk Layar Penuh & Lanjutkan') on TryoutEngine has no data-testid. Expected one of: exam-fs-start / exam-start-button. Add data-testid="exam-fs-start" to enable automated CBT flow completion past the gate (headless Chromium cannot grant real fullscreen so cannot cross the gate anyway, but having the testid lets us detect the gate state).

MINOR testability: TryoutEngine lacks data-testid on font-size controls (A-/A+ buttons) and on the final 'Kumpulkan' submit button. Suggest: exam-font-minus, exam-font-plus, exam-submit. The mobile palette button m-open-palette exists but is not pressable while fullscreen-gate overlay is on top (expected behavior).
No functional fixes required for mobile layout — all 8 device profiles × up to 42 pages = 300+ overflow checks pass with 0 regressions.
critical_code_review_comments: frontend/src/index.css: `html, body { overflow-x: clip; }` is the key fix preventing stray horizontal scroll on any device; works everywhere tested. Good.

iOS auto-zoom guard scoped to `@media (hover: none) and (pointer: coarse)` correctly keeps desktop inputs at 14px while enforcing 16px on real touch devices — verified computed font-size at /login on all profiles.
No data-testid on fullscreen-gate / submit / font controls in TryoutEngine.js — reduces E2E coverage for CBT. Low severity for users, high value for QA.

rca of the issue: User's original complaint ('tampilan mobile hilang di live site') had TWO causes: (1) deployed Vercel index.html had lost its <head> (no viewport meta → desktop width rendered on phones) — fixed by main agent restoring full index.html; (2) several admin pages (ManageUsers, CourseContent, ManageTryouts, TryoutBuilder) and PublicShell overflowed horizontally at 320px due to inline-flex header rows + fixed logo widths + non-scrollable tabs — fixed by wrapping headers (flex-wrap / column on mobile), min-w-0 containers, horizontally-scrollable tabs, and the global index.css safety net (html,body{overflow-x:clip}, text-size-adjust, @media hover:none → inputs 16px). All verified: 300+ overflow probes across 8 device profiles return 0 overflow.
